GEN 9:1.KJV: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.

GEN 9:2.KJV: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.
GEN 9:2.BHSA: וּמֹורַאֲכֶ֤ם וְחִתְּכֶם֙ יִֽהְיֶ֔ה עַ֚ל כָּל־חַיַּ֣ת הָאָ֔רֶץ וְעַ֖ל כָּל־עֹ֣וף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם בְּכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּרְמֹ֧שׂ הָֽאֲדָמָ֛ה וּֽבְכָל־דְּגֵ֥י הַיָּ֖ם בְּיֶדְכֶ֥ם נִתָּֽנוּ׃

GEN 9:3.KJV: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.
GEN 9:3.BHSA: כָּל־רֶ֨מֶשׂ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוּא־חַ֔י לָכֶ֥ם יִהְיֶ֖ה לְאָכְלָ֑ה כְּיֶ֣רֶק עֵ֔שֶׂב נָתַ֥תִּי לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־כֹּֽל׃

GEN 9:4.KJV: But flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.

GEN 9:5.KJV: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man's brother will I require the life of man.
GEN 9:5.BHSA: וְאַ֨ךְ אֶת־דִּמְכֶ֤ם לְנַפְשֹֽׁתֵיכֶם֙ אֶדְרֹ֔שׁ מִיַּ֥ד כָּל־חַיָּ֖ה אֶדְרְשֶׁ֑נּוּ וּמִיַּ֣ד הָֽאָדָ֗ם מִיַּד֙ אִ֣ישׁ אָחִ֔יו אֶדְרֹ֖שׁ אֶת־נֶ֥פֶשׁ הָֽאָדָֽם׃

GEN 9:6.KJV: Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.
GEN 9:6.BHSA: שֹׁפֵךְ֙ דַּ֣ם הָֽאָדָ֔ם בָּֽאָדָ֖ם דָּמֹ֣ו יִשָּׁפֵ֑ךְ כִּ֚י בְּצֶ֣לֶם אֱלֹהִ֔ים עָשָׂ֖ה אֶת־הָאָדָֽם׃

GEN 9:7.KJV: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.
GEN 9:7.BHSA: וְאַתֶּ֖ם פְּר֣וּ וּרְב֑וּ שִׁרְצ֥וּ בָאָ֖רֶץ וּרְבוּ־בָֽהּ׃ ס

GEN 9:8.KJV: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,

GEN 9:9.KJV: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;

GEN 9:10.KJV: And with every living creature that is with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.

GEN 9:11.KJV: And I will establish my covenant with you, neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.
GEN 9:11.BHSA: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֤י אֶת־בְּרִיתִי֙ אִתְּכֶ֔ם וְלֹֽא־יִכָּרֵ֧ת כָּל־בָּשָׂ֛ר עֹ֖וד מִמֵּ֣י הַמַּבּ֑וּל וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֥ה עֹ֛וד מַבּ֖וּל לְשַׁחֵ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

GEN 9:12.KJV: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

GEN 9:13.KJV: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
GEN 9:13.BHSA: אֶת־קַשְׁתִּ֕י נָתַ֖תִּי בֶּֽעָנָ֑ן וְהָֽיְתָה֙ לְאֹ֣ות בְּרִ֔ית בֵּינִ֖י וּבֵ֥ין הָאָֽרֶץ׃

GEN 9:14.KJV: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:

GEN 9:15.KJV: And I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

GEN 9:16.KJV: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.

GEN 9:17.KJV: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.

GEN 9:19.KJV: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.
